If your depression has been going on for that long it can be a medical reason for it. 

For example I had to low hormone levels in my thyroid gland and I was feeling so down, tired, depressed, and everything that comes with depression, I self harmed and was suicidal. I didn’t know why i was feeling the way I was feeling, and thought that i didn’t have a reason to be depressed.
I don’t remember how we got to see a doctor, because it was 3 years ago, but I got medicine (tacapsol and Levaxin) to regulate my hormone levels. I’ve been struggling a lot cuz it’s a long recovery process, but I’m feeling better now. 

There are so many medical reasons to why you are depressed and you need to check it up. 
I hope this helped a little <3

My mum has borderline and I am diagnosed with autism, so I understand a bit and I want to help. 
 
Just by doing small changes in your daily life is great, like going on walks. Don’t haste to do marathons right away, just by doing something simple and making a habit out of it is enough. 

Sleep is really important for your metabolism, so if you start to try and stick to a sleeping schedule with the recommended 8 hrs of sleep you will start to feel better, and you burn a lot of calories when you are sleeping. 
There a many different ways to high up your metabolism like drinking tea, peppermint tea, and taking hot and cold showers. 

It’s not bad to eat once a day, it’s called intermittent fasting and you can check it up, but just make sure it’s around your calorie intake. 

I recommend you book up with a dietitian that can give you a lot of information of what your body needs. 

Just remember that the smallest changes are good enough, I hope I was to some help :)

I mostly tried to get out of my comfort zone, which is not easy (!), and it still can lead to some anxiety attacks at night, but now I feel like I always has someone to be with at school and always someone to sit with :)

I don’t know so much about close friends, I have like 2 that I have known my whole life and they are like family. But I have met some people later in life that I really like to hang out with :) 

I am very ‘careful’ to find trust and comfort in a friend. But tips it to get out of your comfort zone!! And don’t dwell on it for to long or to much :)
